title: Restatement § 45 — beginning invited performance
summary: Beginning or tendering the invited performance of a performance-only offer creates an option.
notes: The chapter quotes the predicate that the offer invite performance and not a promissory acceptance. Beginning protects the opportunity to finish; it is distinct from earning the full reward by completion. The Brooklyn Bridge example and Wormser’s changed view illustrate the point. The full standalone section and its comments should be added from SEL rather than silently reconstructed.
